# Flows

One flow per role, shared by every project. What each flow does, its inputs, its step graph and what each step does: the [Flow manual](https://leweii.github.io/myorch/workflows/) ([中文](https://leweii.github.io/myorch/zh/workflows/)). Fragments (`use:`) are in [lib/](lib/); how to write a flow: [Writing flows](https://leweii.github.io/myorch/#ch-08-flow-syntax).
